label: The existing propositional modal language with existence/rigid-equality atoms is invariant under…
paraphrase: The existing propositional modal language with existence/rigid-equality atoms is invariant under pointwise identical modal reducts. Two exact universal Bool-world extensions share existence/identity/causation and an actually contingent candidate, have sound distinct endpoints and locally well-founded grounding, but differ on whether that candidate is grounded. This is a formal non-entailment, not metaphysical possibility.
